offering_description.value: Underwrites and sells residential property insurance, mainly homeowners and condominium unit owner policies, for coastal homes exposed to hurricanes and other weather. Policies are sold through independent agents and brokers, and the company earns premiums and manages the resulting risk.

primary_products.value: homeowners insurance; condominium unit owner insurance; dwelling fire insurance; commercial residential property insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners and condominium unit owners in coastal areas; B2B: landlords and residential property owners insured through agents

end_markets.value: residential property insurance; real estate; homeowners and condominium housing

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums paid by policyholders for property coverage

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites and bears property risk, selling policies to homeowners through agents and brokers

geography_served.value: US regional: coastal Florida, Texas, Louisiana, the Carolinas and Georgia

specialization.value: niche specialist: residential property insurance for coastal homes

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agencies and brokers that sell its policies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensed and rate-regulated by state insurance departments, such as the Florida Office of Insurance Regulation
